scope.purpose: Independent small rule sample: ordered guards, typed payloads, ordered multiple events and pure constructor-injected computation.

origins.description: This input explicitly defines the sample policy and messages. Not historical truth, not approved production business semantics.

legalDomain.nulls: Excluded. Invalid constructors or malformed snapshots are not converted to business rejection or empty success.
legalDomain.identifiers: WarehouseId, RequestId, SkuId and LocationId: ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._-], length 1..64.
legalDomain.reservationId: Printable ASCII, length 1..384. Length-prefixed identity format is specified separately.
legalDomain.notes: Non-null Unicode String, length at most 256 UTF-16 code units; empty, quotes, backslashes and newline are legal.
legalDomain.availableQuantity: Long, nonnegative. This state already denotes currently available stock, not original total stock.
legalDomain.storedReservation: Positive Long quantity, valid nominal IDs and non-null payload collections.
legalDomain.stateRelations: confirmedRequests is a subset of reservations.keySet. Unrelated entries remain legal and observable.
legalDomain.requestedQuantity: All Long values. Nonpositive quantity is a declared business rejection.
legalDomain.locations: Vector[LocationId], including empty and repeated elements. Coverage is membership, not multiplicity or inventory allocation.
legalDomain.locationNotes: Option[Map[LocationId, Vector[ReservationNote]]], including None, Some(empty map) and nested nonempty values. Opaque payload; keys need not be requested locations.
legalDomain.routing: Warehouse identity is obtained from State; application routing and actor lifecycle are outside this rule sample.
legalDomain.dependency: ReservationIdentity promises deterministic pure output for legal arguments; exceptional violations propagate unchanged. No I/O, clock, random or global registry.

errors.name: QuantityNotPositive
errors.message: Requested quantity must be greater than zero.

errors.name: RequestAlreadyReserved
errors.message: The request already has a reservation.

errors.name: UnknownLocation
errors.message: Every requested location must be registered.

errors.name: StockUnavailable
errors.message: The SKU must exist with sufficient available quantity.

errors.name: ReservationIdentityMismatch
errors.message: The reservation identity does not match the request.

successComputation.name: reservationId
successComputation.evaluation: after all guards, before event constructors

identity.name: ReservationIdentity
identity.encoding: Version prefix, then four pipe-separated segments in argument order. Each segment is decimal UTF-16 length, colon, raw ASCII value. Quantity uses canonical Long.toString. No trailing separator.
identity.purity: No time, randomness, I/O, UUID generation or registry. This new format is not a migration of an old receipt identity.

errors.name: AmountNotPositive
errors.message: Technical example amount must be positive.

errors.name: BalanceInsufficient
errors.message: Technical example requires a sufficient balance in the same currency.

technicalMoneyExample.notes: Exact BigInt values. No MoneyOps String ABI claim, no rounding or balance-change algorithm. Legal balance values are nonnegative.

properties.oracle: Named scenarios with independent expected error records and full typed event observations; no calls to production rules, error adapters or identity implementation to compute expectations.
properties.samplingDomain: Joint bounded recipes, not exhaustive quantification: full signed Long ranges; nominal ASCII alphabet and ID lengths; note text up to 256 UTF-16 units; histories 0/1/2/4; nested vectors 0..5; opaque unregistered note keys; money magnitudes from up to 512 random input bits (the added one can produce a 513-bit result) plus fixed boundaries. Directed properties supplement random sampling.
properties.guardOrderWitness: Positive quantity plus duplicate request plus missing location must reject duplicate before location. Nonpositive quantity plus both failures must reject quantity first.
properties.shrinking: Scenario-specific constraints and failure category preserved; strict measure decrease, no self candidate. Joint state/parameter shrinking retains relations and collection/Option classes, opaque-note-key flag and 0/1/many count categories.

dependencies.productionSupply: NOT_ADMITTED; baseline source is signature evidence only, no private stub or copied CommonTypes
